gaps.quote: The paper's coefficient arrays consist of such values with norm less than $\tfrac14$.
gaps.note: The page does not say which norm is meant, so the bound of one quarter cannot be checked.

gaps.quote: Keeping the norm bounded in this way is what allows the rounding error of a single truncation to stay below the level needed for exact recovery.
gaps.note: The page asserts that the norm bound controls the rounding error without showing how, so the reader cannot check it.
